title: Excellent!
text: Excellent!. These mixing bowls are excellent! They are sturdy. The variety of sizes is nice. They have easy to read measurement units on them. They wash well in the dishwasher. It's been years since I've had a good set of stainless steel mixing bowls.

product_metadata.title: Ayesha Curry Kitchenware Pantryware Stainless Steel Nesting Mixing Bowls Set, 3 Piece, Silver with Color Accent Handles
features: MIXING BOWL SET INCLUDES: 1.5-quart mixing bowl, 3-quart mixing bowl, and 5-quart mixing bowl are dishwasher safe for easy storage
MIX IT UP: Dishwasher-safe, stainless steel mixing bowls from Ayesha Curry nest conveniently together for easy, space-saving storage
PREP BOWL SET: Durable stainless steel mixing bowls look great on the countertop and stand up to busy, creative kitchens
EASY HANDLING: Lightweight ingredient and prep bowls feature colored accent grips (in mustard yellow, redwood red, and anchor blue) to easily move recipes between kitchen stations
STORE AND POUR: Nesting mixing bowls have convenient pour spouts for managing batters, marinades, and sauces
